## Proposed change
<!-- 
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Fixed log spamming (#26782) by making it optional.
The new feature is optional `power_sensor` which is used to enable/disable polling (this also limits the log spamming, if logging is enabled).
The play/paused/off state was previously decoded by text value (eg. "playing", "paused"), which changed with language of the actual MPC-HC, so you had to set it to english to make it work properly. Because MPC-HC provides this state also "by number", I've switched to it and it works with all languages now.
Lastly, there was a problem with MPC-HC response encoding - `media_title` was corrupted with language specific chars, thus I've changed encoding of fetched response from default to UTF-8.
